name: Spine AI
long_description:
Spine AI is a visual workspace where a single prompt spins up a swarm of AI agents that plan, delegate, and execute complex tasks together — with humans fully in the loop.

Instead of chatting back and forth with one model, Spine breaks work into visible steps on a shared canvas. Agents collaborate in parallel, ask clarifying questions, use connected tools, and show their reasoning and intermediate outputs as they work.

Every agent’s work stays inspectable, auditable, and editable — reducing hallucinations and giving you real control over the outcome.

Spine connects to leading AI models and your existing tools, but the real power comes from orchestration: you act as the team lead, Spine runs the swarm.

Chat is great for answers. Spine is built for execution.
one_liner: Manage a swarm of AI agents to get real work done

launches.title: Medley: Give Claude Code missions, not just tasks
launches.tagline: Medley is a free Claude Code plugin for work bigger than one session. Type /mission to turn an outcome into a live dependency graph, coordinate Claude Code and Codex workers, review the assembled result, and keep going.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Medley.

You type **_/mission_** and give it the outcome, the budget, and the constraints. Medley builds a live dependency graph, coordinates Claude Code and Codex workers, reviews what comes back, and keeps going when execution reveals more work. It's free and runs on the subscriptions and API access you already have.

<https://youtu.be/xe7bj3b5Aw0>

## **❌ The Problem**

Coding agents got good at bounded tasks. Once a job outgrows one session, you become the harness. You break the work into prompts, move context between agents, review outputs, and decide what happens next. There's no shared definition of done, so "finished" just means "looks finished."

## **🛠 Our Solution**

/mission takes on that orchestration. Three things sit between your outcome and the models:

* **A contract.** Before any work starts, Medley sets the objective, the acceptance criteria, the constraints and budget, and the conditions that should make it hold or stop. That's what "done" gets measured against later.
* **A live graph.** Medley doesn't write one giant plan upfront or spawn a swarm by default. It plans the next useful set of steps, runs them, reviews what came back, and updates what should happen next. Each node carries a brief, its dependencies, and a verification target. Sometimes one worker should carry a tightly coupled job end to end; when work is genuinely independent, Medley runs it in parallel. Work is routed across Claude Code and Codex workers - and with your own OpenRouter key, Codex workers can run models like Kimi and GLM.
* **An acceptance stage.** When a batch lands, a separate reviewer role inspects the outputs and changed files, runs the contract's verify commands, and decides whether the evidence satisfies the contract - not whether the work merely looks finished. If it doesn't, the mission replans.

You can watch and steer the mission in your browser. Anything that needs your judgment or approval - publishing, sending outbound, spending, contacting people - lands in the attention queue. Everything else keeps moving. 

## **📊 Why This Works**

The model is only the local capability. The harness decides where to apply it - the contract fixes the target, the graph splits the work, routing matches each task to a worker, and an independent acceptance stage runs the real verify commands and replans when the contract isn't met.

Before launch, we pressure-tested a benchmark-specialized version of the same architecture on four complete public benchmarks: 93.25% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 71.37 on HealthBench Professional, 93.24% on ViBench, and 60.98% on DrugDiscoveryBench. Those are the highest reported results on each, and they span coding, healthcare, and drug discovery.

No new foundation model. The gains came from how the work was decomposed, routed, carried across contexts, and reviewed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108332&key=user_uploads/1362282/3af52f57-057a-475d-8bc4-ec0b1531a504)

Full methodology and results are[ on our blog](https://www.medley.sh/blog/the-harness-is-the-capability-multiplier).

## **🙏 Our Ask**

**Try it.** Medley is free on Mac. Install it from Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Spine-AI/medley
/plugin install medley
/reload-plugins
```

Then run /mission.[ ](http://medley.sh/)[medley.sh](http://medley.sh)

**Tell us what you think.** We're shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email [support@getspine.ai](mailto:support@getspine.ai) with what you tried, where it worked, and where it broke - and where you'd want Medley to keep going versus stop and ask.

launches.title: Spine Swarm: Your AI Team for Everything Beyond Code
launches.tagline: Spine gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas to complete complex projects: research, analysis, financial models, prototypes, decks, and more.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Spine Swarm.

**TL;DR**

You describe a project. A team of AI agents spins up, works in parallel on a visual canvas, and delivers finished outputs: market reports, financial models, slide decks, interactive prototypes. Free to get started, no setup needed.

**Ask:** Sign up and try it at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai). We'd love to hear what you build — drop us a note at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai).

<https://youtu.be/vylx9rzC388>

## **❌ The Problem**

AI agents for coding have crossed a threshold. Tools like Cursor and Claude Code let engineers describe a project and come back to finished, working code. That experience doesn't exist yet for the rest of the work that drives a company forward.

As coding gets increasingly automated, the bottleneck is moving upstream: strategy documents, competitive analysis, financial modeling, sales collateral, market research, SEO audits, rapid prototyping. These are multi-hour, multi-step projects that require pulling information from many sources, structuring it, and producing polished output.

Today's AI tools treat this kind of work as a conversation. You get a chat thread, local file management, and one model doing everything sequentially. For simple tasks that works fine. But for complex projects, the single-chat paradigm breaks down. You end up managing the AI instead of letting it manage the work.

We've been building at this intersection for 3 years. Last year we launched Spine Canvas, a visual workspace for orchestrating AI models. Swarm is the next step: the canvas now has autonomous agents that can take on entire projects from start to finish.

## **🛠 Our Solution**

Spine Swarm gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas. You describe the project, and Spine spins up specialized agents in parallel, each handling a different part of the work. You can watch them execute in real time, inspect each artifact as it's created, and edit anything in place.

* **Multi-agent execution:** Spine orchestrates a team of agents across your project. For a competitive analysis, one agent researches market data, another structures the findings, another builds the slide deck. They work simultaneously, not sequentially, and can run autonomously for 80+ minutes on large projects.
* **Intelligent model selection:** We route between 300+ models, picking the best one for each step and ensembling multiple models to override any single model's biases. You don't configure any of this.
* **Visual canvas:** Every artifact your agents produce appears on a shared canvas where you can inspect, compare, edit, and branch. No chat windows, no file systems.

Everything Spine builds is downloadable and hosted at a shareable link. Just send your team the URL.

## **📊 Why This Works**

A common question we hear: "You're using the same models everyone else has access to. Why would the output be better?"

We recently scored **87.6% on Google DeepMind's DeepSearchQA**, a benchmark that measures how well AI answers complex research questions requiring multi-step reasoning across sources:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98705&key=user_uploads/1362282/fb8a5039-8780-455d-abc4-7f3da613aa7b)

Three things drive this:

* **Model routing and ensembling:** Spine selects the best model from 300+ options for each step and ensembles multiple models to override any single model's biases or blind spots.
* **Orchestration:** How you decompose a complex task, coordinate agents across steps, and manage handoffs between them matters as much as the models themselves.
* **Intelligent canvas:** Agents work on a shared canvas where they can read each other's outputs, build on previous steps, and assemble coherent deliverables. This also means every step is fully auditable, so you can trace how agents arrived at their conclusions and verify their reasoning.

Read more about our approach and the full benchmark results[ on our blog](https://blog.getspine.ai/spine-swarm-hits-1-on-gaia-level-3-and-google-deepmind-deepsearchqa/).

## **🚀 Tasks Worth Trying**

* "_Audit \[your website URL\] and produce a full SEO analysis, competitive landscape, and a prioritized growth roadmap with a slide deck._" You'll see agents browsing your site, researching competitors, and assembling deliverables simultaneously.
* "_I'm preparing to fundraise. Here are my company details: \[paste\]. Build me a pitch deck, competitive landscape with market sizing, a financial model, and personalized outreach emails for target investors._"
* "_Here's a product idea: \[describe it\]. Generate three different interactive prototypes and landing pages exploring different design directions, alongside a PRD and go-to-market strategy._"

## **🙏 Our Ask**

* **Try it:** Sign up at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai) and run one of the tasks above. It's free to get started, no credit card required.
* **Tell us what you build:** We're actively shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email us at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai) with what you tried and how it went.

**Share this post** if you know founders, operators, or team leads drowning in the strategic and analytical work that's piling up as code writes itself.

launches.title: Spine Canvas: Unlimited Visual Workspace for AI Thinking
launches.tagline: Think beyond chat. Collaborate visually across 300+ AI models with branching, parallel, and contextual workflows.
launches.body:
tl;dr: Chat is great for Q&A, but real work isn’t linear.

**Spine Canvas** is an unlimited, visual AI workspace that lets you orchestrate 300+ models with a single subscription, think in blocks (Chat, Deep Research, Memo, Image, Slides), branch safely, run in parallel, and keep explicit context across everything.

Get started for free:[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)https://www.getspine.ai

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBq6dDQlO5w 

### **❌ The Problem**

Most AI tools force thinking into a chat thread. That breaks down for real work:

* **Superficial and linear:** useful for one-off answers, weak for exploration and synthesis
* **Context evaporates:** sources get buried; you can’t see what informed which step
* **No safe branching:** testing alternatives means losing your original path (or forking tabs)
* **No parallelism:** ideas wait in line; you can’t spin up multiple streams at once
* **Tool sprawl:** one app for research, another for writing, another for images — context gets lost between multiple AI subscriptions

If you’re doing market/competitive research, strategy, content systems, or product planning, you need an environment that reflects how thinking actually happens: exploratory, non-linear, and iterative.

---

### **💡 Our Solution: Canvas, Not Chat**

Spine Canvas is a visual workspace where your ideas are blocks connected by explicit context. You can see, direct, branch, and re-run your thinking — across hundreds of models — without losing your train of thought.

#### What you can do today:

**Orchestrate 300+ models with a single subscription**

GPT‑5, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Flux, Nano Banana, and more — pick the right model per step and switch mid‑flow without losing context.

**Think in blocks, not threads**

Chat, Prompt, Deep Research, Memo, Image, Slides — each block has an explicit role and visual inputs/outputs, so chains stay modular and interpretable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/d6578fed-e2e5-4e9d-a749-a58b8ab47ccd)

**Organize and (explicitly) utilize all your content in a single workspace**

Paste or drop in PDFs, YouTube links, webpages, and even past LLM chats. Wire them into any block and control exactly what each step uses.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/1e4420c0-d1a2-46fa-82db-cdf54eb15827)

**Branch safely and compare**

Explore alternatives without corrupting your original path. Keep versions side‑by‑side and merge insights when you’re ready.

**Run in parallel**

Take a list (competitors, themes, tasks) and spin out multiple research streams, drafts, or visuals at once.

**Re‑run and evolve**

Update one block and cascade improvements through an entire branch. Iteration becomes automatic and reproducible.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/47204045-5cb7-477e-afc9-55a447f0e165)

Our public roadmap:[ app.getspine.ai/roadmap](https://app.getspine.ai/roadmap)

### **💼 Real Canvases Teams Are Building**

* Market deep‑dives that flow into competitor profiles, battlecards, and executive memos — in minutes, not days
* Content engines that turn one source into outlines, drafts, and platform‑ready assets (with visuals)
* Founder/product strategy rooms mapping interviews (YouTube + PDFs) → insights → counterpoints → product bets → launch plans
* Creative labs exploring concepts, visual directions, and brand systems
* Learning hubs with curated sources, summaries, and living notes

Explore our gallery:[ https://app.getspine.ai/gallery](https://app.getspine.ai/gallery)

### **⚙️ Why This Matters**

* **Transparency:** See what each block knows — no black-box memory.
* **Control:** Direct sources by domain, date, or type; include your own docs and past chats.
* **Speed:** Complex, multi-step work finishes in minutes and stays repeatable.
* **Flexibility:** Model-agnostic orchestration keeps your workflow stable as models evolve.
* **Complete**: Do everything from research to generating presentation slides, images, copy drafts, all without switching tools.

Chat works for Q&A. **Canvas is for thinking.**

### **🤝 Ask**

* Try using a canvas for thinking instead of linear chat threads – build one real workflow (research → memo, content engine, or strategy room) and tell us what clicked.
* Share with teams who live in research, strategy, content, product or learnOps – we’re eager to add more templates based on your feedback.
* YC community: we’re always happy to chat about getting the best thinking out of your AI models — visually for individual workflows, and structurally through company-wide templates.

**Get started for free:**[ ](https://www.getspine.ai)[getspine.ai](http://getspine.ai)

**Join the community:**[ discord.gg/KuHzF6zBPs](https://discord.gg/KuHzF6zBPs)

**Book a chat:**[ calendly.com/intro-getspine/intro](https://calendly.com/intro-getspine/intro)

\
The future of human–AI collaboration is visual, adaptive, and unlimited.

launches.title: Spine Research: Deep research done better
launches.tagline: Iterative deep research reports you can actually use.
launches.body:
**tl;dr** Spine Research searches through **_over 3x more sources 5x faster than ChatGPT Deep Research while keeping you in control_**. With a built-in full-text editor, you can iteratively guide the research, dive deeper into topics, and build and share reports that are actually useful.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cabKW-B9Ung

# ❌ **The Problem**

“Deep research” with AI often isn’t comprehensive, collaborative or controlled. If you’re relying on research for critical decisions, you’ve probably run up against the limitations of current tools:

* **Superficial Overviews:** Most AI tools deliver surface-level summaries. While a starting point, they rarely deliver the nuanced, comprehensive understanding needed for a true competitive edge or complex problem-solving.
* **Static Reports, Not Evolving Understanding:** Real insight comes from asking new questions based on what you're learning, and using that to inform where you need to go next. What if the initial research misses the mark, or you want to explore a specific avenue further? You're often stuck waiting 10-15+ minutes for a complete do-over, losing valuable context and any useful initial findings. Current UX isn't built for the way human understanding evolves – through continuous _refinement_ and building upon prior knowledge.
* **Lack of Meaningful Control:** Struggling to direct AI to your trusted websites, specific authors, or crucial internal documents? Or to exclude irrelevant noise? You end up sifting through low-quality information, wasting time and effort, because you can't effectively steer the research. It's hard to restrict research to just research papers, recent news or local government websites.

 For critical decision-making and professional analysis, today's AI "deep research" often feels frustratingly superficial, rigid, and disconnected from your own expertise.

# 💡 **Our Solution**

Spine AI rapidly generates comprehensive research reports by synthesizing insights from hundreds of websites, academic papers, news articles, and private documents—delivering deeper, more accurate understanding in a fraction of the time taken by ChatGPT's Deep Research. 

You're in full control to iteratively define the scope, depth, and breadth of analysis to perfectly suit your needs.

1. **Guide your process from the start:**\
   Start with your prompt and guide the research process immediately. Spine AI generates an initial outline you can quickly edit. Refine its scope, focus, or sources in minutes, ensuring precise alignment _before_ full report generation, so you don’t have to wait 15 minutes to realize you forgot to include a key detail about scope.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcL5A3u_PiTNIcT2zA_EuBzfnd1KkxzSX96-X_IXZip1X55JeOpSlewO6VSh2UnshndNmMQ0CIQLX2AJXZnl63DSKevcmLfEEZbmYFx4kNp4hSAMh6O8fSbOreW-syDJtskuGvYWg?key=Y1LxsXqmD3SyMDO0vvbfTw)

2. **Control the process and build your understanding iteratively:**
   * **Breadth of sources:** When searching the open web, Spine AI accesses over 3x more sources than ChatGPT’s deep research, giving you a more comprehensive view with detailed citations out of the box. You can also exclude irrelevant domains, keeping unreliable sources out of your reports.
   * **Focused discovery:** Direct Spine AI to focus on particular types of sources (like news, financial reports, or research papers), specific websites, and set publication timeframes, to ensure the most relevant information.
   * **Leverage your own sources:** Upload and research your own private documents—proprietary reports, project files, spreadsheets, slide decks—integrating your internal knowledge with external discovery.
   * **Model Agnostic:** Maintain flexibility by choosing the LLM (including OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini models) that best suits your current needs or preferences. Your core research workflow remains stable, even as individual model capabilities evolve.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcT9SBLuKPWhEOCBukznBQTa76nsdbme7j2Tid7-TYTDxW-fxfMF37AHn7GwxQBR-b5E1rxcu9GWpjbdKWLgcoJV7q9SMyH0-ToypIKq63YfCWSBg1BTjXOle7IUb4h_GZ-DaGjJw?key=Y1LxsXqmD3SyMDO0vvbfTw)

3. **Directly add your expertise:**\
   Spine AI isn't just about AI-generated content; it's a dynamic working document. You can type directly into your research, add your own notes, edit the generated text, and incorporate your unique context and analysis alongside the AI's findings. Close the gap between just another research doc to organize, and actually creating a usable report, or project doc.

# 🤝 **The Ask**

**Put us to the test.**

Need to build quick expertise on a new topic or simplify your research process?. Find out about how the [recent executive order on drug pricing could shift the market](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/62ab8a56-e0d5-4380-a991-18bf4fc2ffd0?utm_campaign=bookface), [what US-China trade negotiations could mean for startups and VC](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/0ee2928d-e0c9-4aea-b277-45f347d2b07d?utm_campaign=bookface), or [where Stripe is sitting in the market](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/105e8d40-36fc-4092-8555-853cf5865b40?utm_campaign=bookface). Also great for getting a handle on the latest research ([how much do we really know about ozempic?](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/ff4177f6-105f-4954-9fdd-a50261beae32?utm_campaign=bookface)), or whatever else you have questions about.

**Try us out for free!**

And with the YC promo code (YCLAUNCH), you can get $25 off our pro plans.

Know a founder, investor, analyst, or tech enthusiast who needs better research tools? Let them know about Spine AI. **Share with deep research power users**, and see if they don’t want to make the switch.

launches.title: Spine AI – The Multi-Modal AI Analyst Platform for Reliable Insights
launches.tagline: Simplifying data exploration at scale with AI analysts tailored to your business context
launches.body:
# Tl;dr

Accessing and synthesizing data is a challenge, with existing tools requiring too much effort and expertise.

**Enter Spine**: An AI-powered data platform built for decision-makers that handles your data in any format. Teach it your business context, to get reliable answers from databases, documents, and websearch. Gather your insights in customizable reports that automate multi-modal analysis and keep insights traceable.

To celebrate F24 Demo Day, **we’re offering free access** to a YC dataset in Spine, giving investors and observers a deep dive into batch F24’s companies, founders, and opportunities.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/425f4b5e-1eb5-48a6-bf02-25e69412564d)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/365e8fa7-e9c5-4489-adb3-281393120488)

# The problem

There is no shortage of data and information, or reasons to access it. Improving operations, identifying the most successful initiatives, or clarifying key drivers of revenue. But accessing and synthesizing this information from various sources can be an uphill battle.

Many tools available for working with data make it difficult to get to the right information without significant time and effort. Technical experts often have to unlock access for decision makers, and even then, critical details locked in documents, slide decks, or PDFs are hard to uncover and integrate effectively. 

While platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini offer “chat with your data” functionality—such as answering questions about uploaded spreadsheets or generating text-to-SQL queries—they don’t go far enough. None of these solutions offer an end to end solution that’s suitable for scalable use.

**You need to already have the right data, in a clean format, and not too much.** The big LLM providers can find some new information for you, but it can’t give you structured data at scale, and it’s not up to date.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/243f0c39-bd31-4246-9230-a330465ccdd1)

**It’s not enough to just do text to SQL.** It can speed up querying, but there’s a lot of business context that needs to be applied to make answers accurate and useful, and Custom GPTs don’t cut it. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/7f42be7d-d2d5-434c-8854-37792f39dc9d)

**There’s no good way to update information, add more data, or deal with multiple formats and sources at the same time.** People often don’t know the best place to find the information they are looking for, and most LLMs can’t help with that at scale.

**You can’t easily collect the insights you’ve generated from LLMs, share them, or re-trace your steps if there are questions about the source.** If you want to replicate a similar process for your analysis there’s no straightforward way, especially if it involves multi-modal data.

The major BI and analytics tools solve some of these problems, but they don’t really deliver on conversational functionality, and definitely don’t support multi-modality.

Which is why we’ve built a better way.

# The solution

Spine is a multi-modal AI analyst platform designed for decision-makers, delivering an end to end solution which includes:

**Explore and enrich data**

* Either start from scratch or add on to your existing data. Combine structured data, documents, and websearch for a unified view.
* Pull in data for competitive analysis, market research, benchmarking and more.

**Domain knowledge management customized for your use case, and ongoing evaluations for reliable updates**

* Our platform makes it possible to adjust, and test the integration of domain knowledge at scale, so you know updates work and are an improvement over what came before. 
* We generate 1000s of samples for each of our analysts, capturing issues so we can solve them, and know objectively that our changes improve performance.

**Integrations for your existing data sources**

* We work with data of all types, integrating with platforms like Google Drive, BigQuery and Snowflake, and industry specific tools like iLevel. Any tool that has an API can be set up.

**Transparent answers for users**

* Our AI analysts always show their work, so users can verify where answers are coming from and how they were created.
* If the analyst finds a question it’s not confident in answering, it notifies the user and gives them the option to submit to a human to verify its work.

**Customizable reporting and repeatable analysis**

* Full control and flexibility in reports and dashboards. Insights can be added directly from the chat, gathering information from structured datasets and documents.
* Create templates to automate multi-modal analysis, enabling you to apply the same framework seamlessly across multiple entities, such as different companies or similar data sets.

**In honour of Demo Day**, we’ve put together a [free preview of Spine](https://yc.getspine.ai/sign-up) with a dataset for batch F24’s companies and founders (plus as a bonus, data on all YC companies). 

If you’re an investor:

* Don’t miss out on discovering the best of the best. You can get a comprehensive overview of who’s in this batch, what they’re doing, and which companies are most similar, and figure out which are best suited for your investment thesis.
* Track the companies you’re interested in, and create a more focused view to compare them.
* Upload pitch decks and documents from founders to enrich the dataset we’ve given you, and pull key insights from them, such as traction, TAM estimates and GTM strategy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/517013a9-2a07-4c8b-abef-0ea809e7ad5c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/47430f02-c20c-42d8-9376-8591fc3d9058)

# The ask

**Try this free preview of Spine for YC F24 Demo Day!**

[Sign up](https://yc.getspine.ai/sign-up) and learn about the companies launching with this batch (or explore all companies in the YC directory!)

**Reach out if you’re interested in the full version of Spine**

We’ve worked with a number of investors in the VC space, but we’ve also created AI analysts for market research, sales data, and user facing experiences for B2B SaaS products.

If you think you could be doing more with your data, [reach out.](https://www.getspine.ai/talk-to-us)

**Spread the word**

If you like what you see, share it with someone you think would find it useful. \
Share this post, and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/95072305/admin/feed/posts/) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Spine_AI).

launches.title: Spine AI - Reliable AI data analysts that know your business
launches.tagline: Custom AI analysts, trained on your business context, so you can ask truly plain language data questions and make informed decisions frictionlessly
launches.body:
## tl;dr

Spine creates reliable AI analysts that make it easy to get the right data to drive decisions. We capture and embed your business context, to enable real plain language data questions. Instead of spending time struggling with inflexible dashboards, or translating questions to queries, just ask questions and get answers. Empower internal decision makers, or your customers, with interface options that integrate with existing workflows.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdtqKjuSuQpHE3TjAm_itXPgRLQtQgySxCTM0ReLQsAw3Gp_7wvbUIcGzUlUdy_WnNHsxizF0yn7oyA3Eb6ompQWp1RItXp80w1zaZWFZoAZgUQ4-Yk36b65S3_8LSTE5QTYAdgjqKrhkkzSBg6ZF45FUg?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

# The problem

From having built over 200 copilots for companies and having processed more than 100k user queries here are some of our key learnings:

* Analytics and business intelligence are critical to running any organization. They allow leaders to understand what’s working, what’s not, and where they can find new opportunities.
* Most existing BI tools are inflexible and technical. To find answers to novel questions requires knowledge of the data model, or a BI specific query language.
* In practice, it's not always obvious what you'll need to know to respond to an evolving situation, or what new questions your data will raise. Static reports and dashboards create dead ends. You can get stuck waiting for someone from the data team to be available, or having to act on best guesses.
* And it's not just internal decision makers who face these challenges. Your customers can only interact with their application data through:
  * static dashboards that require engineering teams to build,
  * custom reports your support teams and analysts put together, and/or
  * data exports that require expertise to dissect
* While the extraction of information from unstructured sources has evolved, handling structured data remains a challenge:
  * Beyond accurately deciphering user intent, structured data often comes with messy table schemas and unwritten business context, for which there are no established methods of embedding in the models.
  * Simply having models generate complex SQL and/or code to process the data makes the execution less transparent, flexible and reliable.
  * Isolating data across multiple tenants and user access controls remains a barrier in making this a customer facing feature.

## The solution

We build custom AI analysts that allow any user to ask plain language questions about their data, and get reliable answers.

**Plain language questions and natural exploration**

With the chat interface, users can easily explore their data, asking questions in their own words, instead of "translating them" to a formal query. When the results raise new questions, just ask them. No searching for the right report, or getting stuck at a deadend in your dashboard.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXezHViIBc3TQimN4FoYsmGAuqFJ_lFgAQU8rTAGqPTGqoQmaN1l_FIxEwl8RvNWwRNJDQrVqL3w1ur0ziFjU069dzbYTwvorccXTDYPsPjD4CSqnRUMWnu4s89MT5Lgy-XfA3dqZJ5XunVddCXzeh97aw?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

**Revisit crucial insights**

Once you’ve found insights in your data, it’s easy to come back to. Get regular notifications for key questions, collect insights into shareable reports, or add them to flexible dashboards.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefxA1bWXpTkzW8hQBEekKMhZ4W3KPKIdetddq-1FWALX804CujEpigd2dQJjFVsEYVqE8MTsMRRzJ9mB6ahQkKQ7Rpxatwyp8AUgaVdLWKz0B8neUCiXXWM6uQbQWQXeFOwBBVHNETGCQGvQa5U1TJUrc?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

**Transparent and reliable answers**

Even on a single table dataset Spine’s AI analyst performs 15x better than GPT-4o out of the box.

Rather than leveraging models to generate complex SQL or code (or find answers from the data directly), our solution leverages a proprietary Data Processing Unit (DPU) that comprises a collection of refined modules.

The DPU enables us to:

* have individually tested and schema/domain fine-tuned modules that work at scale
* react to the data and modify the operations we take to get the answer
* explain the steps taken by the AI in a simple human readable manner

During the customer onboarding process, we capture and embed the business context and the schema understanding into the DPU modules. Additionally we build and maintain data and schema-specific semantic layers, across tables, which makes it possible for us to accurately interpret and handle natural language questions across multiple tables with over millions of rows each.

Finally, a combination of automated and human evaluations give us an objective way of measuring performance — both before and after we deploy the analyst.

**Diverse use cases**

We are able to support use cases across diverse industries and user bases by systematically gathering domain specific knowledge from our customers, and automatically inferring relevant data characteristics. Whether you’re in finance, retail, healthcare, telecoms, manufacturing, or any other industry, we can create an AI analyst for your business.

**_Sales analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdfoY8qAC_h6o37VqJhc9laUNLLsm2WoauY11Wzkq5Xn30kUo3sOqSGh5QQh8Z0In23MiAu5rTmss7DsZEFkpNUqwbVjH8-7lkmjcQTWE03g1U_Ce7bU_J5Tnaa34Om9RUW7onhyfiMfZBYYDhIg2bv82s?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Understand what outreach activities are getting attention, with who. Dig into team member performance, email deliverability and more, to better understand what’s effective and what’s not performing.

**_eCommerce platform analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdmVxwj3U-ohPX90hds_V_0qkRzBioVUgAOa7mZn0dJb3Bds-NSWsJAI2bfrQSnwVkAlwQ9n_KxmSXWXouOgqy4Tof9-GabGM6CC36-DMWTw53EJt8TuP5AYKCIJhxhWsXsU_aO9V0ZimmY5AW4FzW6Gg?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Gain insights into which products are selling the most and why. Analyze customer behavior, optimize inventory management, and uncover trends in purchase patterns to maximize your sales potential.

**_ERP system analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd_waVQSpbeRpOB3ZZjq_YGuu4scesyVCwj7txYLLoy6oyIzVUoSxEKyDuvkkjnXfG3JekB8U5Oq_I_wsbfAQSxLtdNw2QHrm6Yu9HQfmNQ5lMv7fLm1Sduavs0PyO3Fie2eqHih2I4amlPDb8exr_dy3I?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Keep projects on track by monitoring task progress, timelines, and budget adherence. Evaluate project performance, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.

**The power and flexibility of AI without needing a technical team**

You don’t need your own AI team. Have your custom analyst up and running in the next 30 days, and leave the upkeep to us. Monitor and tune the analyst’s behavior over time with our admin panel.

# About us

We are Akshay and Ashwin – the co-founders of Spine AI 👋. We've been friends for over a decade, with our shared journey beginning at the University of Waterloo. Our interest in machine learning took root in an unlikely place – a building called _Spine_ at the Nanyang Technological University in Singapore during an exchange term.

And in our first year we’ve grown! Across our team, we collectively collaborated with more than 45 enterprises, guiding them toward the next levels of AI maturity. We have more than 100+ citations in GenAI and patents in AI and data processing. Our team also has experience working at companies like Nvidia, Shopify, Instacart, Amazon, Epic Games as well as founding multiple YC companies.

## The ask

launches.title: 🚀 Spine AI – Propel your products forward with AI copilots
launches.tagline: Spine AI’s platform helps you build a copilot for your product.
launches.body:
**_Tl;dr_**_: Spine AI simplifies the process of integrating AI copilots into your products. Now, complex tasks within products like JIRA, such as custom reporting or bulk updates, can be effortlessly managed. Simply have your users instruct our AI copilot and watch as it seamlessly executes your commands. Interested in the power of AI copilots for your products? We're just a message away!_

![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/WbKO1Pu6llFXV2BkVDpIZq_OxQHZqlQkGdXmWfSfgo9d-OsXV5GsUxwJZCRRzuZnxKhkAAibbms9Hi-zyfyklPV7OTkwhabjFUWi7es3qMRaHL1VekA9vtQgboExpAf_oZXHyPt3RkAO7V-3_wq1ijE)

Hello everyone, we are Akshay and Ashwin – the co-founders of Spine AI 👋. We've been friends for over a decade, with our shared journey beginning at the University of Waterloo. Our interest in machine learning took root in an unlikely place – a building called _Spine_ at the Nanyang Technological University in Singapore during an exchange term.

In the past five years, we've collaborated with more than 45 enterprises, guiding them toward the next levels of AI maturity. This year, we've successfully integrated LLM-related technologies into over six companies, leading to a clear projected ROI. This journey has brought some key insights to light:

* The gap between creating a text generation prototype with tools like OpenAI and deploying a value-adding product is significant.
* Customer expectations are evolving, with [hybrid UI paradigms (command + intent)](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ai-paradigm/) becoming increasingly prevalent.
* To maximize their benefits, AI copilots must perform actions on users' behalf, saving time and creating new workflow possibilities. This is the core functionality of our Spine-powered copilots.

### 💪 The Power of AI Copilots

* AI copilots streamline complex UI workflows, morphing them into an intuitive, natural language-based interface.
* Adding an AI copilot to B2B products is becoming table-stakes (as seen with [Shopify](https://twitter.com/tobi/status/1679114154756669441?s=20), [Microsoft](https://www.barrons.com/articles/microsoft-stock-ai-software-ad2baf04), [Notion](https://www.notion.so/product/ai), etc.) for companies that have the capacity to build them. At Spine AI, we're on a mission to democratize this.
* When added to enterprise SaaS products, AI copilots have helped companies increase ARR by $1M. 💰
* AI copilots enhance your product by adding an intelligence layer that directly connects users to backend APIs, documents, and databases, making previously challenging workflows easily implementable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73256&key=user_uploads/1362282/06ca9a30-c100-4c04-87e3-64e7438b361d)

### 💢 The Problem

* Developing reliable AI copilots, which offer a wide range of functionalities, demands a significant investment of time and resources, requiring extensive AI and engineering expertise throughout the entire lifecycle.
* Embedding diverse actions into the copilots, such as API calls, documentation updates, multi-modality, and authentication handling, can extend the development timeline beyond six months.
* The addition of complex features, like custom reporting and integrations, can further prolong the development cycle, putting additional strain on already-packed roadmaps.

### 🎯 The Solution

* Enter Spine AI – the easiest way to build reliable AI copilots for your products. Our platform converts API docs, DB schemas, and multi-modal documents into fully operational AI copilots that integrate effortlessly with just a few lines of code.
* During the setup process, each copilot is equipped with a custom orchestrator, trained to effectively transform user intents into concrete actions.
* Maintain complete control over the product interface with the ability to customize the permitted actions, enabled workflows, and the copilot's response style to users.
* Once integrated, the AI copilot becomes a superuser of your product – an indispensable assistant always at your users' disposal, enabling them to harness your product's full potential.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73256&key=user_uploads/1362282/43dd32fe-2473-482c-9da0-ab5577b8c551)

### 🤝 Ask: How you can help

* If you're a B2B company exploring ways to integrate AI copilots into your products effectively, we'd love to [hear from you](https://www.getspine.ai/)!
* If you're unsure how Spine can streamline your complex workflows, drop us a note at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai)

Help us spread the word! Please share this post and join our journey by following us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/95072305/admin/feed/posts/) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Spine_AI).
